name: Fear & Greed extreme-fear contrarian long (spot)
rationale: The Crypto Fear & Greed index (alternative.me, 0-100, bounded and mean-reverting) is the canonical crowd-sentiment gauge: extreme fear marks forced/emotional capitulation that historically mean-reverts at a swing horizon. Because the index is BOUNDED (not a drifting level), a fitted floor genuinely binds across the whole sample — it is NOT the always-true/false trap that kills raw-level features (phase0-social §4). Hypothesis: entering LONG spot when Fear & Greed is in its extreme-fear band captures the post-capitulation bounce; we hold until sentiment recovers (signal exit) or risk limits hit. This is a deliberately LOW-TURNOVER signal (extremes are infrequent, holds run days-to-weeks) so the thin per-trade edge is not eaten by spot taker fees — the failure mode that killed the high-turnover intraday families. Disconfirmer 1 (orthogonality): a price-only oversold control (RSI/drawdown entry) is in the same cohort — if it matches or beats this spec's deflated Sharpe, the edge is just 'buy the dip', not sentiment, and Fear & Greed adds no orthogonal information. Disconfirmer 2 (regime depth): the index has ~3 years of history over essentially one bull-bear cycle; the purged+embargoed holdout (recent slice) must stay positive, else this is cycle-position-in-disguise that reverses out-of-sample. The Gate is the disposal layer — an honest FAIL is a valid result.
catalyst: Fear & Greed enters the extreme-fear band (crowd capitulation)
